title: The Violet Circle
logline: SAMPLE. Three days in the Viola stand: noise when it hurts, memory when it thins, Italy when the call comes, then a name for who you were this week.

questions.scene: Away night. Fiorentina one down. The Viola end is still loud.

choices.label: Keep the songs going. Noise is the point.
Drop into a hard silence. Let them feel the stare.
One short burst, then rebuild. Save the throat for the equaliser.

questions.scene: The home end has found a chant about the purple. They want a reaction.

choices.label: Louder. Same songs. Do not give them a new script.
Turn your back as one. Make the pitch the only stage.
Smile and point at the badge. Let the shirt answer.

questions.scene: The night thins. Someone near you names a Viola ghost to keep the stand warm.
questions.prompt: Whose name do you reach for?

choices.label: Batistuta. The number nine who made Florence feel inevitable.
Toldo. The wall when the season felt like weather.
Chiesa. The home boy who ran like the city was watching.

questions.scene: International week is coming. Italy will call. The Viola shirt is still on your back tonight.
questions.prompt: Where does your first loyalty sit this week?

choices.label: Fiorentina first. The club carries the ordinary days.
Italy first when the Azzurri need a body. Club waits.
Both, without apology. Different fires. Same fan.

questions.scene: Five questions. One away night. Your Stand for Fiorentina this week needs a line.

choices.label: Loud when it hurts.
Quiet steel. Memory-led.
Club and country. No clean split.

questions.cliffhanger: Tomorrow: Part 2. The equaliser never came. The bar under the away end is still open.

questions.scene: SAMPLE. Next GST day. The result is already history. The conversation is not.
questions.prompt: In the bar, what do you defend first?

choices.label: The effort. They ran. That still counts here.
The idea of the team. Style even when points fail.
The truth. Name what was soft. Love does not mean silence.

questions.scene: Someone mentions a striker who left Florence and made noise elsewhere. Vlahovic. The room splits.
questions.prompt: What is your Stand on players who leave?

choices.label: Thank them for the purple years. Wish them well. Keep walking.
Cold when they wear the other shirt. Warm for the memory only.
Judge the exit, not the person. Business is business. Football is feeling.

questions.scene: A younger fan asks why Biraghi still matters when the timeline moves on.

choices.label: Longevity is a kind of love. Showing up is the badge.
Captains carry weather. Not just armbands.
Every era needs a spine. Find yours in the current shirt too.

questions.scene: Derby talk drifts in. Juventus. Old scars. Fresh noise.
questions.prompt: How do you carry rivalry into the week?

choices.label: Fuel. Keep it sharp. Matchday only gets louder.
Quiet contempt. Save the voice for our own.
Joke first. Steel second. Do not let them live in your head.

questions.scene: Day two closes. Your Fiorentina Stand has a second line.

choices.label: Grace for those who leave. Fire for those who stay.
Truth in the bar. Noise in the curva.
Rivals outside. Memory inside.

questions.cliffhanger: Tomorrow: Part 3. The last circle. Who you are when Florence is far and the shirt is still close.

questions.scene: SAMPLE. You are not in Florence. The stream is late. The group chat is early.
questions.prompt: How do you keep the Stand alive from away?

choices.label: Full kit energy. Watch like you are in the end.
Quiet ritual. Same seat. Same scarf. Same hour.
Bring someone new into the chat. Grow the tribe.

questions.scene: A clip of Cuadrado in purple rolls through. Then another club. Careers are long. Loyalty is a choice.
questions.prompt: What do you celebrate in a player who passed through?

choices.label: The joy they left in the stand. That is enough.
Only the years they were truly ours.
The whole arc. Florence was a chapter. Chapters matter.

questions.scene: Italy play tonight. Someone asks if the Viola fan softens for the Azzurri no matter who wears the shirt.

choices.label: Yes. Nation nights are a different altar.
Only if our people are on the pitch. Otherwise I watch cool.
I cheer the idea of Italy. I bleed purple the other six days.

questions.scene: One more memory lands: Borja Valero. Control in the middle. Quiet class.
questions.prompt: What kind of Viola hero do you honour most?

choices.label: The thunder. Goals that shake the stone.
The metronome. The one who makes the team breathe.
The survivor. Seasons of weather without leaving.

questions.scene: Chapter end. The Violet Circle closes. Your Stand gets a final name.
questions.prompt: Who were you across these three days?

choices.label: The loud pilgrim. Noise as love.
The memory keeper. Names as shelter.
The hybrid. Purple and Italy. No apology.

questions.cliffhanger: Chapter complete. Share your Stand. Next: sa.fiorentina.ch02 when commissioned, or pick Italy / Henry.

day_wall.headline: Part complete for today
day_wall.body: You used today's five questions. The Violet Circle continues tomorrow at midnight GST.
